title: Zero space bound forces no work tapes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $f$ map binary words to binary words, and let $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that on every binary input $x$, $M$ halts with output $f(x)$ at some time while using at most $s(|x|)$ work-tape cells. If $s(n)=0$ for at least one natural number $n$, then $M$ has zero work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$f$ maps binary words to binary words
$M$ computes $f$ on every binary input within the space bound $s$
